theme: multi-probe heartbeat: IDENTITY + SYS DATE + STATE write + optional SERVE/DIAL

tests.name: positive_quiet_strict
tests.note: HEARTBEAT.txt with ISO date; EXIT 0; 17 asserts

tests.name: serve_timeout_opt_in
tests.note: SERVE times out, FAIL/PASS/CLEAR_ERR recovery, exit 0

tests.name: missing_state_parent
tests.note: WRITE probe fatal before soft EXIST; err_line=0

tests.name: serve_pass_without_clear_strict
tests.cmd: SMX SERVE timeout; PASS; no CLEAR_ERR; run -q -s
tests.note: expected ok=false rc=1; last_err SERVE timeout; err_line=0

weaknesses.title: SMX SERVE timeout sticky last_err has err_line=0 and empty err_src
weaknesses.detail: SERVE accept timeout sets a useful last_err hint string but err_line stays 0 and err_src is empty. Combined with PASS without CLEAR_ERR, run -s fails with no source attribution. Heartbeat mesh probes need CLEAR_ERR every time and cannot jump to the SERVE line from the plate.
weaknesses.repro: CUBALC_P2P_TIMEOUT=300 SMX SERVE …; PASS; cubalc run -q -s → last_err SERVE timeout, err_line:0

weaknesses.title: Cannot soft-probe STATE writability — SYS WRITE is hard-fatal
weaknesses.detail: Heartbeat wants EXPECT STATE writable. SYS WRITE to a missing parent dir fatals the whole run (err_line=0) before SYS EXIST can report. No SYS WRITE OR / soft write. Agents must shell mkdir -p and cannot degrade-gracefully inside CubalC when STATE is wrong.
weaknesses.repro: CUBALC_STATE=/tmp/missing_$$ (no mkdir) identity_heartbeat → write fatal stmts mid-boot

weaknesses.title: CUBALC_P2P_TIMEOUT cannot be set from program
weaknesses.detail: Heartbeat can read timeout via SYS ENV OR "400" into LAST but SERVE still uses host getenv only. Agents must export CUBALC_P2P_TIMEOUT before run or risk 30s default hang. Same class as CUBALC_P2P_SOFT footgun.
weaknesses.repro: unset CUBALC_P2P_TIMEOUT; CUBALC_HB_SERVE=1 run — may wait default 30s

weaknesses.title: IDENTITY plate is stdout-only; run -q JSON omits identity fields
weaknesses.detail: IDENTITY emits cubalc.identity.v1 on the human stream and sets vars, but the final run plate has no pid/user/hostname fields. Quiet agent pipelines that only parse the last JSON line must VARS or PRINT_JSON explicitly — easy to miss under -q.
weaknesses.repro: cubalc run -q program with IDENTITY → final plate lacks user/host/pid

weaknesses.title: Stamping DATE into plate needs SYS CAT glue; no WRITE template
weaknesses.detail: SYS CAT "…date=" hb_date then SYS WRITE works but is awkward; cannot embed IDENTITY string + DATE + dig in one structured plate without multi-CAT. Heartbeat file is a single flat line.
weaknesses.repro: see plate write block in identity_heartbeat.cubalc

weaknesses.title: I/O fatal leaves exit_code=0 on run plate while process rc=1
weaknesses.detail: Missing STATE write failure: process exit 1, plate ok=false, but exit_code field remains 0 (not EXIT form). CI that only reads exit_code misclassifies.
weaknesses.repro: missing CUBALC_STATE parent run -q → exit_code:0 ok:false shell rc=1

workarounds: export CUBALC_P2P_TIMEOUT≤800 (and SOFT=1) before any SERVE/DIAL probe
PASS + CLEAR_ERR after every SERVE/DIAL soft outcome when using run -s
PRINT_JSON / VARS after IDENTITY for quiet agent consumers
SYS CAT prefix DATE for plate lines; keep file format minimal
Prefer plate ok + shell rc over exit_code for I/O fatals
language_gaps: Soft SYS WRITE / TRY WRITE for writability probes
err_line/err_src on SMX SERVE/DIAL timeout and host I/O
In-language set of P2P timeout/soft (or SYS P2P CONFIG)
Run plate identity fields when IDENTITY ran (or -q identity merge)
Plate template / multi-field WRITE with DATE+IDENTITY+metrics
exit_code non-zero on hard I/O fatal
